Task T2 is complete:

- **Plan:** `out/T2/plan.yaml` — for each of the 16 layers, `concat`s the kept row/column ranges of `query_key_value.weight`, `query_key_value.bias`, and `dense.weight` into temporary `*.pruned` tensors, `delete`s the originals, then `move`s the pruned tensors back to the original names. Includes the required shape/count asserts plus per-layer sanity asserts.
- **Run:** executed once (`.venv/bin/brainsurgery out/T2/plan.yaml`), succeeded on the first attempt — all asserts passed.
- **Output:** `out/T2/model.safetensors`, verified to have exactly 244 tensors, correct pruned shapes (`[5376, 2048]`, `[5376]`, `[2048, 1792]`) on every layer, float16 dtype preserved, values bit-exact against manually-sliced/concatenated references from the input checkpoint, and all non-head-bearing tensors byte-identical to the input.
- **Report:** `out/T2/REPORT.md` written per the template.
